name: Manufacturing Systems, Automation & Quality
summary: Organising and controlling production: process planning, lean, statistical quality control, automation, robots and smart factories.

topics.name: Production systems: job shop, batch, flow line and cellular manufacturing
Process planning and computer-aided process planning (CAPP)
Production planning and control: scheduling and inventory
Lean manufacturing: value-stream mapping, 5S, kanban, SMED
Statistical process control: control charts and process capability (Cp, Cpk)
Six Sigma, DMAIC and quality management systems (ISO 9001)
Industrial automation: PLCs, sensors, conveyors and material handling
Flexible manufacturing and automated assembly systems
Industry 4.0: industrial IoT, digital twins and smart factories
Facility layout and discrete-event simulation of manufacturing systems
